What's the copay on the Gold plan?
The Gold PPO (plan ID P101) has a 10% copay — meaning after your deductible is met, you pay 10% of each covered service and the plan pays the rest. — Benefits information only, not medical advice.

That's a fair concern, and I'm glad you asked. The Silver HMO (plan ID P102) has a 20% copay after your deductible is met. — Benefits information only, not medical advice.
